title: Flux resources gain Suspend/Resume/Reconcile actions — grant them in RBAC deliberately

detection.reason: fires when Flux HelmRelease objects exist — the first of the Flux kinds that gained actions; the same applies to Kustomization, GitRepository, HelmRepository and the other kinds in the note

quote: If you want to use these actions do not forget to update the permissions (RBAC) for your Argo CD instance.
remediation: Add `applications, action/<group>/<Kind>/<action>` rows to argocd-rbac-cm for the Flux kinds your users should be able to suspend, resume or reconcile from the UI; wildcards on `action/*` already include them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get helmreleases,kustomizations,gitrepositories -A -o name 2>/dev/null | head -20 # objects printed gain UI actions at 2.13 — check who may run them

title: Flux resources now carry health — Applications managing them may change health status

detection.reason: fires when Flux Kustomization objects exist; HelmRelease, GitRepository and the other Flux kinds in the note gain the same health checks

quote: `Custom Resource Health` has been added for Flux Resources. The following Flux resources now support health checks:
remediation: Expect Applications that deploy Flux objects to report Progressing/Degraded according to the Flux resource's own Ready condition; update any automation that assumed those objects were always Healthy.
verifyCommand: kubectl get kustomizations,helmreleases -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select([.status.conditions[]? | select(.type=="Ready" and .status!="True")] | length != 0) | .kind + " " + .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # objects printed are not Ready — their Application turns Degraded or Progressing at 2.13

title: Bundled Dex 2.39: the LDAP connector rejects credentials with special characters

detection.reason: the Dex connector configuration is the VALUE of argocd-cm's `dex.config` key; ConfigMap values are not collected

quote: The validation of username and password in the LDAP connector is much more strict now. As of today, Dex uses the EscapeFilter function to check for special characters in credentials and prevent injections by denying such requests.
remediation: If `dex.config` declares an `ldap` connector, test logins for users whose names or passwords carry LDAP filter characters (`*`, `(`, `)`, `\`) before upgrading — Dex now denies them.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get cm argocd-cm -o jsonpath='{.data.dex\.config}' | grep -c 'type: ldap' # 1 or more = an LDAP connector is configured

title: Jobs started manually from a CronJob get a 2-digit-year name postfix

detection.reason: the naming of Jobs that operators start from the UI is runtime behaviour, not inventory

quote: The naming of Jobs that are manually started from CronJobs (using Argo CD) was changed. Instead of the previous postfix `-YYYYMMDDHHmm` (4-digit year), manually started Jobs now receive postfix `-YYMMDDHHmm` (2-digit year).
remediation: Update any automation that matches manually started Job names on the 4-digit-year postfix.

title: Repository proxy settings are now passed to `kustomize build`

detection.reason: repository Secrets carry a `proxy` KEY the agent projects, but Argo CD may live in any namespace and the projection has no repository-type marker outside the argocd namespace — a namespace-pinned read that finds nothing must not read as "no proxy configured"

quote: Proxy config set on repository credentials / repository templates is now passed down to the `kustomie build` command.
remediation: Confirm the proxy configured on those repositories can reach the remote resources your kustomizations fetch (remote bases, Helm charts) — from 2.13 kustomize builds go through it too.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n argocd get secret -l 'argocd.argoproj.io/secret-type in (repository,repo-creds)' -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.data.proxy != null) | .metadata.name' # secrets printed set a proxy that kustomize build now uses

title: Built-in health checks added for 29 resource kinds — Applications that deploy them can turn Degraded or Progressing

detection.reason: objects of these custom resource kinds, and their current health, are not collected; the hint names the installed CRDs whose group and kind are on the list (group and kind are matched separately, so a CRD pairing a listed group with another listed group's kind is named too) (PodDisruptionBudget has its own rule)

quote: * policy.open-cluster-management.io/CertificatePolicy * policy.open-cluster-management.io/ConfigurationPolicy * policy.open-cluster-management.io/OperatorPolicy * policy.open-cluster-management.io/Policy * PodDisruptionBudget * cluster.x-k8s.io/MachinePool * lifecycle.keptn.sh/KeptnWorkloadVersion * numaplane.numaproj.io/ISBServiceRollout * numaplane.numaproj.io/NumaflowControllerRollout * numaplane.numaproj.io/PipelineRollout * rds.aws.crossplane.io/DBCluster * rds.aws.crossplane.io/DBInstance * iam.aws.crossplane.io/Policy * iam.aws.crossplane.io/RolePolicyAttachment * iam.aws.crossplane.io/Role * s3.aws.crossplane.io/Bucket * metrics.keptn.sh/KeptnMetric * metrics.keptn.sh/Analysis * numaplane.numaproj.io/MonoVertexRollout * helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/HelmRelease * image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/ImagePolicy * image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/ImageRepository * image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/ImageUpdateAutomation * kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/Kustomization * notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/Receiver * source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/Bucket * source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/GitRepository * source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/HelmChart * source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/HelmRepository * source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/OCIRepository
remediation: Objects of these kinds start counting toward their Application's health at this version: one the new check reads as Degraded or Progressing turns its Application Degraded or Progressing and holds later sync waves. Check the status of these objects in the Applications that deploy them before upgrading, or override a kind with `resource.customizations.health.<group>_<Kind>` in argocd-cm.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(IN(.spec.group + "/" + .spec.names.kind; "policy.open-cluster-management.io/CertificatePolicy", "policy.open-cluster-management.io/ConfigurationPolicy", "policy.open-cluster-management.io/OperatorPolicy", "policy.open-cluster-management.io/Policy", "cluster.x-k8s.io/MachinePool", "lifecycle.keptn.sh/KeptnWorkloadVersion", "numaplane.numaproj.io/ISBServiceRollout", "numaplane.numaproj.io/NumaflowControllerRollout", "numaplane.numaproj.io/PipelineRollout", "rds.aws.crossplane.io/DBCluster", "rds.aws.crossplane.io/DBInstance", "iam.aws.crossplane.io/Policy", "iam.aws.crossplane.io/RolePolicyAttachment", "iam.aws.crossplane.io/Role", "s3.aws.crossplane.io/Bucket", "metrics.keptn.sh/KeptnMetric", "metrics.keptn.sh/Analysis", "numaplane.numaproj.io/MonoVertexRollout", "helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/HelmRelease", "image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/ImagePolicy", "image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/ImageRepository", "image.toolkit.fluxcd.io/ImageUpdateAutomation", "kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/Kustomization", "notification.toolkit.fluxcd.io/Receiver", "source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/Bucket", "source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/GitRepository", "source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/HelmChart", "source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/HelmRepository", "source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/OCIRepository")) | .metadata.name' # CRDs printed gain an Argo CD health check at 2.13 — check the status of their objects in your Applications

title: PodDisruptionBudgets now carry health — a PDB with a failing condition turns its Application Degraded

detection.reason: names PDBs with a False condition whose reason is not InsufficientPods, which is exactly what the 2.13 PodDisruptionBudget health check reads as Degraded (conditions projected by agent 0.4.144+)

remediation: Each PodDisruptionBudget named here reads Degraded from 2.13 (typically `DisruptionAllowed=False` with reason `SyncFailed`: the controller cannot evaluate its selector or the pods it covers), and so does the Application that deploys it. Fix the PDB before upgrading, or override `resource.customizations.health.policy_PodDisruptionBudget` in argocd-cm.
verifyCommand: kubectl get pdb -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(any(.status.conditions[]?; .status == "False" and .reason != "InsufficientPods")) | .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name' # PDBs printed read Degraded under the 2.13 health check
